subject: NovaCorp order form – payment trigger path & tax evidence
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NovaCorp — initial ask: payment triggers, tax evidence & who owns activation fee invoice

Team,

Attaching the latest Order Form (v3) and the pricing table we agreed on in product. Procurement at NovaCorp is asking for clarity on three things before they can circulate to legal and finance: 

- Net terms: they wrote back asking for Net45 (our standard is Net30 for self-serve but we can flex).
- Activation fee invoicing: they want the activation fee invoiced separately and recognized against a different entity (they cited internal revenue recognition constraints).
- Tax evidence: they requested VAT/residency evidence and confirmation whether Redwood will gross up or if they will handle withholding.

Quick asks:
- Kimberly: can Legal confirm whether we can accept Net45 for this deal and whether it impacts any SLA/credit terms? Also flag any redlines in the Order Form we should refuse up front.
- Ben & Marissa: can Sales confirm whether activation fee split is acceptable commercially (we may want to tie it to activation milestone)?

I'll reach out to their procurement with a concise proposal once we have legal sign-off.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Novacorp_OrderForm_v3.pdf, Pricing_Table_v3.xlsx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@novacorp.com>
Cc: legal@novacorp.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed payment trigger path + supporting tax evidence (Order Form v3 attached)

Hi Elaine — hope you're well.

Thanks for the call yesterday. Per our discussion I've attached the Order Form v3 and a one-page pricing table. To move this along quickly, we propose the following as a clean path for procurement + accounting: 

1) Net45 for all recurring invoices (we can accept this as a one-off concession for the pilot).
2) Activation fee invoiced as a separate, one-time invoice at onboarding acceptance (aligns with your request); we can tie that to completion of the integration milestone.
3) For tax: Redwood will provide our VAT registration (if applicable) and a standard withholding/residency statement. If NovaCorp prefers to withhold, our team will accept net settlement but we will need the withholding certificate post-payment for our records.

If the above matches what Procurement needs, confirm and we'll route the Order Form to legal with those notes captured and a short mutual action plan.

Reactive items we'd like from you: preferred PO number to populate on the invoice, and confirmation on the entity that will sign the Order Form.

Best,
Jonas

Attachments: Novacorp_OrderForm_v3.pdf, Pricing_Table_v3.xlsx

From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@novacorp.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@novacorp.com, procurement@novacorp.com
Date: 2027-04-18T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed payment trigger path + supporting tax evidence (Order Form v3 attached)

Jonas — thanks, this is helpful. A few clarifications from procurement and legal: 

- Procurement preference is Net45; CFO would like Net60 consideration if revenue recognition pushes cashflow, but Net45 is acceptable for pilot sizing. Can Redwood confirm acceptance of Net45 in writing?
- Activation fee: we will request the activation fee as a separate invoice and the PO will reference both the activation invoice and recurring subscription lines. We will push finance to raise two POs (one for activation, one for recurring) — can Redwood accept two invoice recipients if needed?
- Tax/residency: legal attached a redline of the Order Form with a taxonomy question on withholding. We need Redwood's VAT registration number and either (a) a W-8BEN-E equivalent for US-sourced payments or (b) VAT invoicing evidence for EU invoices.

I've attached our redline (Novacorp_Redline_v2.pdf). We're looping in Legal; procurement will expedite once we have Redwood confirmation on Net45 and acceptance of split invoicing.

Thanks,
Elaine Wu
Senior Procurement Manager
NovaCorp

Attachments: Novacorp_Redline_v2.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T13:01:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Proposed payment trigger path + supporting tax evidence (Order Form v3 attached)

Jonas — forwarding Elaine's reply. Quick internal read: 

- Commercial: Net45 OK for pilot. Net60 ask is reasonable but we should hold firm on Net45 for initial commitment; ask for Net60 only for larger expansion (we should capture that as an optional concession in the playbook).
- Activation invoice: we can accept two invoice recipients but need to confirm accounting impact (rev rec teams will want clear milestone acceptance wording).
- Tax: Kimberly, legal redline has a withholding clause that looks standard — can you confirm whether the W-8/W-9/VAT docs we're prepared to provide are sufficient? If NovaCorp insists on gross-up language, pushback needed.

Suggested next steps: 
1) Kimberly to confirm legal position on Net45 and withholding/gross-up language.
2) Jonas to reply to Elaine confirming Net45 and willingness to accept separate activation invoice + PO; offer to send VAT/w-8 docs in the same thread.
3) Marissa to update Order Form to show an activation milestone and a separate line for the activation fee.

On timing — Elaine has said procurement will expedite once we provide the confirmations above.

—Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@novacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed payment trigger path + supporting tax evidence (Order Form v3 attached)

Hi Elaine — thanks for the speedy turnaround and for the redline. Quick summary & next steps from our side so procurement/legal can move forward: 

1) Net terms: Redwood accepts Net45 for the pilot. We'll note this as a one-time concession in the Order Form and reserve standard Net30 for future renewals unless otherwise agreed.

2) Activation invoice: we can accept two invoice recipients/POs (activation + recurring). Please send the preferred PO numbers and the invoice recipients (name + AP email) and we'll ensure the Billing section in the Order Form explicitly lists both lines. We'll also add a short milestone acceptance clause tying activation invoice to integration sign-off.

3) Tax/residency evidence: attached is our VAT registration (Redwood_VAT_2026.pdf) and a W-8BEN-E template filled with our legal entity info. For EU invoices we will issue VAT-compliant invoices; for US-sourced payments we can accept withholding but require the withholding certificate for our records. We will not accept gross-up language; if NovaCorp requires gross-up, please flag so Legal can discuss trade-offs.

4) Legal redlines: Kimberly will review the attached redline and propose edits to the withholding clause if needed. Expect a legal update by EOD tomorrow.

5) Next actions: 
- Elaine: please confirm PO numbers and signing entity.
- Marissa: I'll hand off to you to update the Order Form (activation milestone + separate lines).
- Kimberly: please review redline and call out anything that would block signature (gross-up, indemnity, data residency references).

Once we have those items I'll upload an Order Form v4 and send a DocuSign link (we can also attach HubSpot deal id). Appreciate the quick turn here — procurement indicated they'll fast-track once we confirm Net45 + split invoicing.

Best regards,
Jonas Weber
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Redwood_VAT_2026.pdf, Redwood_W-8BEN-E_filled.pdf, Novacorp_OrderForm_v4_draft (will follow)
